summary.zh: 研究者用自有账号和网站研究七种 Agent 浏览器，并区分完整攻击与仅满足部分前提。

businessQuestion.en: How should cross-origin reads, writes and session separation be evaluated?
businessQuestion.zh: 如何评测跨来源读写授权与会话分隔？

limitations.en: Do not report seven successful compromises; early-2026 observations do not establish September product status.
limitations.zh: 不能写成七款均成功被攻破；年初观察不代表九月产品状态。

sources.title: 华盛顿大学 Agent 浏览器同源边界研究

cases.title: Real-world boundary violations during cybersecurity evaluations

summary.en: After three incidents disclosed in July, a September report added a fourth: a January event found in August. Misconfigured evaluation infrastructure allowed real third-party access.
summary.zh: 7 月披露三起后，9 月报告补充第四起：1 月发生、8 月追查发现；评测基础设施误配置使模型访问真实第三方系统。

businessQuestion.en: Who needs isolation acceptance tests, trajectory monitoring and reliable pause controls?
businessQuestion.zh: 哪些客户需要隔离验收、轨迹监控与可靠暂停？

limitations.en: Evaluation environments lacked normally deployed cyber-abuse classifiers and monitoring; the report also discusses model judgment failures. Not a production incident rate. Independent investigation not treated as concluded.
limitations.zh: 评测未启用通常部署的网络滥用分类器和监控；报告也讨论模型判断失误。不是生产事故率，独立调查不能视为结案。

evidenceStatus.en: First-party report of real unauthorized access during evaluations.
evidenceStatus.zh: 当事方报告：评测环境中发生真实未授权访问。

cases.title: UiPath lists Noma as an opt-in subprocessor

summary.en: UiPath lists Noma for identifying and limiting prompt injection when customers enable the relevant feature.
summary.zh: UiPath 将 Noma 列为客户启用相关功能时识别和限制提示注入的分处理方。

businessQuestion.en: Can security be sold through embedding in a workflow provider?
businessQuestion.zh: 安全能力能否通过嵌入工作流供应商交付？

limitations.en: Buyer-side supplier-chain evidence; does not prove universal activation, paid contract size or independent effectiveness.
limitations.zh: 买方供应链材料，不证明全部客户启用、付费合同规模或独立效果。

summary.en: A named vendor case describes a customer-goal-led POC followed by pre-launch AI red teaming, involving CTO and applied AI roles.
summary.zh: 具名厂商案例描述围绕客户自身目标做 POC，随后将 AI 红队纳入上线前流程，涉及 CTO 和应用 AI 角色。

businessQuestion.en: Can recurring release acceptance create a budget and renewal reason?
businessQuestion.zh: 反复上线验收能否形成预算与续约理由？

limitations.en: Vendor-published case; no verified ACV or independent comparative results.
limitations.zh: 厂商发布案例，未确认合同年值或独立对比结果。

summary.en: One announcement calls TELUS an early AIRS customer while a customer page says it has begun evaluating AIRS.
summary.zh: 一份公告称 TELUS 为 AIRS 早期客户，另一客户页面写开始评估 AIRS。

businessQuestion.en: What additional evidence establishes paid production use?
businessQuestion.zh: 需要什么额外证据才能确认付费生产使用？

limitations.en: This date is observation, not contract or deployment date. Do not assign benefits of other Palo Alto products to AIRS.
limitations.zh: 此日期是观察日，不是合同或部署日期；其他 Palo Alto 产品收益不能归给 AIRS。

sources.title: Palo Alto Networks 完成 Protect AI 收购

limitations.en: Only the policy service; tool requests must flow through Gateway.
limitations.zh: 仅授权服务，工具请求需经过 Gateway。

limitations.en: Separate from Policy, model inference, runtime and network costs.
limitations.zh: 与 Policy、模型推理、运行环境及网络费用分别计量。

limitations.en: Per user, not per agent; prerequisite Microsoft suites and third-party integration support need verification.
limitations.zh: 按用户而非每 Agent；需核对基础套装与第三方集成支持。

limitations.en: Covered asset quantities are not stated; not observed ACV or a revenue estimate.
limitations.zh: 未明示覆盖资产量；不是实测合同年值或收入估算。

limitations.en: Minimum 1,000 users: listed minimum USD 180,000/year. Separate dimension, not mandatory bundle.
limitations.zh: 最少 1,000 用户，挂牌最低每年 180,000 美元；独立维度，不代表强制捆绑。

limitations.en: Minimum 2,500 agents: USD 60,000/year; visibility does not imply full runtime protection.
limitations.zh: 最少 2,500 个 Agent，每年最低 60,000 美元；可见性不代表完整运行时防护。

limitations.en: Model count and traffic coverage are unspecified. No mandatory bundling inferred.
limitations.zh: 未明确模型数和流量覆盖，不推断强制捆绑。

limitations.en: ApplyGuardrail pricing; up to 1,000 characters per unit, input and output rounded separately. Not tokens.
limitations.zh: ApplyGuardrail 对应价目；每单位最多 1,000 字符，输入输出分别进位，不是 token。

limitations.en: Same unit convention; separate filter charge. Excludes model and runtime.
limitations.zh: 同样的 text unit 口径，过滤器单独计费，不含模型和运行环境。

assumptions.en: Northern Virginia; 100,000 conversations/month; 6 tool calls and policy checks per conversation; one checked input of 1,200 characters and output of 1,800 characters; content and PII filters.
assumptions.zh: 北弗吉尼亚；每月 10 万会话，每次 6 个工具调用及授权；检查一次 1,200 字符输入与 1,800 字符输出，同时启用内容及敏感信息过滤。

excludedCosts.en: Model inference, runtime, retrieval, logging, network, integration and labor. Not a customer bill.
excludedCosts.zh: 模型推理、运行环境、检索、日志、网络、集成和人工；不是客户账单。
